articles.title: ‘Standing on one leg’: IMF chief warns about global economy as AI circular financing hits $1 trillion
articles.description: Kristalina Georgieva says circular financing among AI companies has grown to just over $1 trillion, two-thirds of it debt, as investor enthusiasm cools

articles.title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
articles.description: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.

articles.title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
articles.description: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.

articles.title: China confirms Xi-Trump-Putin historic summit. What will be on the agenda?
articles.description: The talks are expected to focus on issues including nuclear non-proliferation, the Middle East war, trade policies and, possibly, the Ukraine war.

articles.title: Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3
articles.description: Harvard’s gold ETF share count rose nearly 20-fold in Q3, while Dartmouth kept its positions in Solana and Ether staking ETFs unchanged.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin flips to ‘total bull’ on a faster route to quantum-safe Ethereum
articles.description: A proposed system would combine bulky digital signatures into a shared proof, helping protect wallets without making every payment much more expensive.

articles.title: Tech world's calls for Jensen Huang to return to Nvidia are growing

articles.title: Cardano holders vote down $5 million bid to buy warehouse copper

articles.title: AI is reshaping banking jobs – but its ability to drive profits remains unclear
